thread:
Anya: Customer asked for a tiny pilot: eval-triggered alerts + automated quant recs + sensible batching/caching defaults. Keep to 2 weeks.
Mike: I can take batching/caching defaults. I'll propose two small profiles: low-latency and cost-save.
Claire: Alerting: customer wants a single threshold for their golden set, suggest default 7% but allow per-route override. Alert should include drift_pct, example prompts, suggested_action.
Srini: For quant recs, recommend SAFE (int8) vs EXPERIMENTAL (mixed-int4). SAFE requires a 1-hour smoke eval before applying.
Kevin: Need canary path for any auto-applied quant rec: 5% traffic for 24h, compare error and latency, auto-revert on regression.
Anya: Action list: Mike -> defaults PR; Srini -> quant rec decision logic; Claire -> alert UX + opt-in; Kevin -> canary tooling checklist. Meeting tomorrow 10am to lock.
